description: This file implements the core functions of the CCSP CWMP Protocol Processor, including object creation, initialization, object enrollment, and cleanup. It defines how the CCSP CWMP Processor object is created, configured, and destroyed, providing foundational behaviors for CWMP protocol handling in the CCSP architecture.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE CcspCwmppoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new CCSP CWMP Processor object, setting up fundamental object functions and context handles.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmppoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with the CCSP CWMP Processor object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmppoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrollers and creates necessary sub-objects such as timers and interface structures required for CWMP processing.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmppoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the CCSP CWMP Processor object, setting member variables and function pointers to default or specific implementations.
